title: Pie Face
description:
Over the summer of 2017 I took my turn suffering at Fuel (as most Ottawa devs did in the 2010's). I basically joined as they were starting to build a mobile version of the children's board game Pie Face, took over the project, completed it, then left the company!

![](/assets/projects/career/pie-face/screenshot-1.webp)![](/assets/projects/career/pie-face/screenshot-2.webp)![](/assets/projects/career/pie-face/screenshot-3.webp)

This game involved challenging friends to a brief minigame, after which the winner gets to throw a pie at the loser. The pies came in a wide variety of "flavors" and were applied to the target's profile picture as a visual effect.

![](/assets/projects/career/pie-face/screenshot-4.webp)![](/assets/projects/career/pie-face/screenshot-5.webp)

The game itself was absurd and failed to become a runaway success, but it was plenty of fun to build, especially working with artists to set up a pipeline for defining new pie types that could be applied to any arbitrary profile picture (you can't tell from these screenshots, but the victim's face would actually pop out like a 3D model and animate, on top of the special effects added to them).
